Messages.Author: Chris Mattern
Messages.Body:
Faethor (fae...@winternet.com) wrote:

: Does transfering blood<-->pool via a Blood Doll constitute the

: master phase, or can you tranfer, and then proceed with your master
: phase?

Transferring blood with a Blood Doll happens during your master phase
but does not use a master action. You can use your master action to
play a Blood Doll and use the Doll to transfer blood immediately before you
leave the master phase.

Chris Mattern

Messages.Author: JoeHallie
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <50irhm$2...@blackice.winternet.com>,

Faethor <fae...@winternet.com> wrote:
> Does transfering blood<-->pool via a Blood Doll constitute the
>master phase, or can you tranfer, and then proceed with your master
>phase?

It is just an effect that you may implement before or after your
master phase action (an action can be used to play a Master card, or
to perform some other action like recouping pool from an investment).

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <50l61d$9...@newsbf02.news.aol.com>,

JoeHallie <joeh...@aol.com> wrote:
>Remember that if you use a master out of turn than you may not
>use your Blood Doll

You couldn't under the Jyhad rules, but under the VtES rules (with
master phase actions and all that), you still get your master
phase even after playing a Master: Out-Of-Turn, so you could still
use the Blood Doll.

Messages.Author: James Puzzo
Messages.Body:
JoeHallie (joeh...@aol.com) wrote:
: Remember that if you use a master out of turn than you may not
: use your Blood Doll

Um, as far as I know, that is incorrect. Since using a blood doll does not
use a master phase action, you do not need to have an action available to
be able to use a blood doll... namely if you have played an out of turn master.

But feel free to wait for a ruling.

-spongy

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
JoeHallie wrote:
>
> Remember that if you use a master out of turn than you may not
> use your Blood Doll

Sorry Joe, thats not the case. Blood doll is used during your master
phase but does not count AS a master phase action. Also note that an
OOT Master no longer eliminates your entire master phase - it just
eliminates a master phase action.

Robert

> Does transfering blood<-->pool via a Blood Doll constitute the
